title: Measurement baseline
description: Numbers measured at a point in time, kept immutable so later changes can be compared against something real. A new measurement is a new file, never an edit to an existing one - that is what makes a regression visible.

name.description: Short slug identifying what was measured.

description.description: What this measures and what a future reader should compare against it.

measured_with.description: The exact command that produced these numbers, so they can be reproduced.

reference_ops_by_seed.description: Keyed by seed. Op counts must be stable for a given seed; drift means the instrumentation or the generator changed.

reference_ops_spread.description: Max minus min ops across seeds. A large spread means variants differ in difficulty, which players will feel as inconsistent scoring.
